title: Sign in
metaDescription: Sign in or create an account to save your progress, streak and results.
lead: Enter your email and we’ll send you a sign-in link. Your account is created the first time you sign in.
sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works for one hour.
notConfigured: Accounts aren’t enabled on this version of the app yet. Content is available without signing in.

errors.invalidEmail: That doesn’t look like an email address.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.failed: We couldn’t send the link. Please try again.
errors.callback: The link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
